mechanism: A directed acyclic graph {{topology}} that allows branching ({{parallelize}}) and merging, but forbids cycles. It models complex dependency chains where tasks can run concurrently but must respect precedence.
invariants: Acyclic: no path leads from a node back to itself.
Rooted: exactly one node has no predecessor, named by `root_id`.
Nodes with no directed path between them may run concurrently.
failure_modes: Cycle on insert: an added edge closes a loop, which the acyclicity invariant forbids and which must be detected at insertion rather than at traversal.
False precedence: an edge asserts a dependency that does not exist, serialising work that could have run concurrently.
